clips.title: The story
paras: At Tidus Stair, two tauren shamans seek insight from the coastal water spirits. Broad stone terraces rise above the Merchant Coast southeast of Ratchet, sheltered beside the Great Sea.

Waves crash below the weathered stone terraces of Tidus Stair, cut into the coastal bluffs southeast of Ratchet. The Barrens around you are arid and dusty, and skirmishes trouble the region, but this stretch above the Merchant Coast is quiet. A modest hut stands on the terraces, home to the tauren Islen Waterseer and Mahren Skyseer. Far from the goblin trade docks, they spend their days fishing, watching the horizon, and seeking insight from the coastal water spirits.
